description: Describes the status of a dispensary's menu_integration

menuIntegrationPartner.description: If a menu_integration is enabled, this will contain details on the provider. Will be null if no integration exists or if it has been disabled for this dispensary.

name.description: The name of this menu_integration partner.

settingsUrl.description: The URL for the settings page for this menu_integration partner.

signupUrl.description: The URL where users can sign-up for this menu_integration partner.

isActive.description: Indicates that this menu partner is active. Does not mean this particular dispensary is correctly configured.

menuIntegrationKey.description: The menu_integration_key associated with this dispensary. Should match the URL parameter.

menuIntegrationEnabled.description: Indicates if the menu_integration for this dispensary is currently enabled.

totalItemCount.description: The total number of non-deleted items. Hidden items are included in this count.

integratedItemCount.description: The number of items with an external_key. Presense of that key indicates the menu item is sourced from an external system.

manualItemCount.description: The number of items without an external_key. Absense of that key indicates the menu item is sourced from the Leafly Menu Manager.

lastSyncedAt.description: An RFC3339 Datetime indicating when this menu was last synchronized.

lastModifiedAt.description: An RFC3339 Datetime indicating when this menu was last changed. If this doesn't match lastSyncedAt, the last menu sync led to no changes.
